title: Number of the Beast, Forehead, 666 & Cube — Revelation / Potatoverse Atlas
status: biblical research + exact Timic primary recovery + provenance controls
purpose: Separate what Revelation says about beast, mark, forehead, hand, name, number and 666 from Tim's own 2026 cube/forehead language, then map genuine structural overlaps without turning project symbolism into biblical geometry.
core_distinctions: Revelation relates mark, beast-name and number-of-name within one allegiance/economic-control system; it does not say the visible digits 666 must be printed on every forehead.
Tim's own May 11 formulation is different: he says '666 is the cube itself' and later 'when they are this, then their forehead is this number'.
Tim's recovered wording does not use either 'on the forehead' or 'in the forehead'; archive paraphrase should preserve that distinction.
No recovered May 11 wording says a physical cube sits inside/on the forehead.
No recovered May 11 wording directly connects forehead to pineal or single Eye.
Biblically, 666 is the beast's number; the Bible does not identify 666 with a cube.
Saturnian/Moon/beast cube is lower enclosure; Heaven Cube is separately defined by Tim on Apr 9.

quotes: 6 6 6 refers to specific math and shapes and a cube
2026_04_16.context: Cube described as compression/depersonalization system; Saturday/Chronos/Saturn/prison and black-cube/soul-trap themes are discussed in project/esoteric language.
2026_04_16.significance: Earliest currently recovered direct Tim wording explicitly joining 6-6-6 to cube/shape mathematics.

quotes: 666 is the cube itself, the dice, the 6 sidees. a polygon. 6 triangles, and 6 points
when they are this, then their forehead is this number
2026_05_11_161524Z.surrounding_content: The cube contains the seed 'to frame and contain and make smaller'.
2026_05_11_161524Z.resolved_meaning: Cube=666 is direct Timic identity language, not merely representation. Forehead-number follows from 'when they are this'—a state/identity consequence. Physical cube-in-forehead, pineal, Eye, mark and seal are not explicit in the recovered wording.

2026_05_11_161911Z.content: Cube is associated with accuser, wrestling with God, Tree of Strife, falling and ego while Tim says 'I am new jerusalem, at the north… I am the ladder to heaven'.
2026_05_11_161911Z.significance: Lower Cube/fall/accuser system is contrasted in the same conversation with upper New-Jerusalem/North/Ladder architecture.

2026_08_10.content: Kronos/Saturn, Saturnian cube, 666/number-of-beast, Farm, Tree of Strife, box/contract, Moon, souls, cows and farmers are placed into an enclosure/restriction interpretation.
2026_08_10.significance: Saturnian Cube becomes one application of the older Cube=666 equation rather than its origin.

revelation_13_sequence.project_relevance: The closest structural overlap with Tim's Cube is controlled belonging: mark/name/number + commerce/access + enclosure/contract. Tim independently adds a geometric/compression equation not present in Revelation.

beast_side.meaning: beast mark on hand/forehead conditions economic access
beast-mark on forehead/hand tied to worship/allegiance

his name shall be in their foreheads
god_lamb_side.meaning: New Jerusalem ends with divine-name identity

forehead_as_identity_and_allegiance_site.central_insight: Revelation gives rival forehead identities: Father/Lamb seal-name versus beast mark-name-number. This is an external biblical parallel to Tim's state→forehead-number formulation, not proof that Tim intended the same textual mechanism.

hand_forehead_pair.interpretive_model: Forehead may symbolize public identity/allegiance and hand action/participation; this is interpretation informed by broader biblical sign traditions, not Revelation's explicit dictionary.
hand_forehead_pair.project_relation: Tim's May 11 statement makes forehead-number depend on what 'they are', which strengthens an identity-state reading more than an anatomical reading.
hand_forehead_pair.boundary: Do not equate modern IDs, payment systems, vaccines, chips or biometrics with the mark without evidence.

number_of_the_beast.ancient_variant: 616 is an early attested variant known already in antiquity.
number_of_the_beast.nero_gematria: Major scholarly interpretation links Hebrew-form Nero Caesar to 666, with 616 sometimes explained through variant spelling; debate remains.
number_of_the_beast.solomon_layer: 1 Kings 10:14 / 2 Chronicles 9:13 record 666 talents of gold; Bodner & Strawn argue Revelation may recall exploitative royal wealth.
number_of_the_beast.project_rule: Biblical 666 should be read first in beast-name/allegiance/economic-access context; Timic cube mathematics is a separate interpretive layer.

cube_geometry_in_timic_language.function: compression, enclosure, reduction of larger/living potential into bounded frame.
cube_geometry_in_timic_language.interpretive_note: Some geometric wording is internally imprecise in ordinary mathematics—a cube has six square faces, while six triangles/six points could refer to other constructions. Preserve Tim's wording as symbolic geometry rather than silently correcting it into a different shape.
cube_geometry_in_timic_language.best_current_definition: Cube=666 in Tim's May 11 system means a six-coded enclosure/compression state that frames/contains the seed and produces the forehead-number identity of those who 'are this'.

forehead_cube_relation.resolved: No direct cube-in-forehead statement recovered. The sequence is Cube=666 → cube contains/compresses seed → 'when they are this, then their forehead is this number'.
forehead_cube_relation.mind_identity: identity/state is supported; mind remains interpretive
forehead_cube_relation.mark_seal: biblical comparison only in currently recovered source
forehead_cube_relation.moon_saturn: not explicit in May 11 excerpt; appears in Apr 16/Aug 10 surrounding development
forehead_cube_relation.contract: explicit later in Aug 10 Farm/Saturnian Cube application

father_name_vs_beast_number.revelation_contrast: Revelation 14 places Father/Lamb name on foreheads immediately after Revelation 13's beast mark/name/number system.
father_name_vs_beast_number.project_relevance: Potential polarity: Source/Father-name identity ↔ Cube/Beast-number enclosure identity; Tim's own May 11 New-Jerusalem/North/Ladder contrast makes this comparison especially useful while remaining retrospective.
father_name_vs_beast_number.warning: Do not identify modern people as literal apocalyptic beast-followers based on project role labels.
